prompt: 读短文,判断下列陈述的真假。
passage: Hi! I am Mike. Today is my mum's birthday. It is fine and warm. We have a big party at home. My dad wears a blue suit. My mum wears a red dress. She looks beautiful. My sister wears a yellow skirt. I wear my new white shirt. We eat a big cake. Everyone is happy.

subQuestions.stem: Mike's sister wears a blue skirt.
It is fine and warm today.
Everyone is happy at the party.

source_ref: 占位题 · 风格参照 C 套 第 IX-(A) 题
note: 阅读判断题:5 道子题,3 T + 2 F。F 题用「主语张冠李戴」+「颜色错配」两个真题常用策略。短文涵盖 family / clothing / weather 三个 vocab_domain,适合 Phase 2 AI 出题学习。
